datasets.title: HDX HAPI Data for North Macedonia
datasets.description: This dataset contains data obtained from the HDX Humanitarian API (HDX HAPI), which provides standardized humanitarian indicators designed for seamless interoperability from multiple sources. The data facilitates automated workflows and visualizations to support humanitarian decision making. For more information, please see the HDX HAPI landing page and documentation .. [Source: This metadata record was automatically extracted from the Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX); Original dataset: https://data.humdata.org/dataset/hdx-hapi-mkd]
datasets.details: HDX HAPI is refreshed daily, but the source datasets may have different update schedules. Please refer to the source datasets for each subcategory to verify their specific update frequency.

entity.name: Armed Conflict Location & Event Data Project (ACLED)

lineage.description: HDX HAPI aggregates standardized humanitarian indicators from multiple authoritative sources (ACLED, INFORM, UNHCR, WFP, OPHI) into a unified API framework for North Macedonia. Data are collected through established monitoring systems and integrated into common administrative and temporal reference structures to enable interoperable humanitarian analysis and decision support.

sources.name: Armed Conflict Location & Event Data Project (ACLED)
sources.description: Provides conflict event records including fatality counts and event classifications for North Macedonia.

sources.name: INFORM
sources.description: Provides national risk assessment including hazard exposure, vulnerability, and coping capacity indices.

sources.name: Oxford Poverty & Human Development Initiative
sources.description: Provides multidimensional poverty indicators including headcount ratios and deprivation intensity.

sources.name: UNHCR - The UN Refugee Agency
sources.description: Provides refugee and person of concern population statistics by origin and asylum location.

sources.name: WFP - World Food Programme
sources.description: Provides food security and nutrition indicators for affected populations.
